title: Jer Junkman
body:
Description

Jer Junkman is an NPC who buys resources from players in the Resource Hub. Prior to the map update, he operated in his junkyard. Selling goods via Jer Junkman has a 5% value reduction compared to selling in the furnace.

Appearance

Jer Junkman sports a short white beard and hair that is bald in the middle. He wears no shirt, only a brown work overall, he has brown shoes with white accents.

Dialogue

"Sell your materials here!" - interaction prompt

When no resources are brought to the Resource Hub:

  • "Hey there! I heard you might have some goods for me. Bring me any types of materials such as stone or wood and i will give you a hefty sum of cash!"
    • Okay! (Ends conversation)

When you bring resources to the Resource Hub:

  • "Are you sure you would like to sell me all these precious goods for [Total_Price]?"
    • Yes please. (Sells your materials and gain money)
    • Heck no! (Ends conversation)
